metadata.description: Version 1 answer of vibe prompt path --json: the absolute path of one generated system-prompt artifact with its size, digest and freshness. A stale or missing artifact is reported as stale or missing with the build that fixes it, never as an empty path, because an empty path is the one answer a shell alias turns silently into a broken launch.
lane is AGENT-LANE.md, what a launch delivery points at; system is the API prefix SYSTEM.md.
The verdict of vibe prompt check, verbatim.
